headword: {平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}

definitions.explanation: How long people (or animals, or products) are expected to live on average; in statistics, life expectancy at birth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: Japan has a long average life expectancy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: Women's average life expectancy is longer than men's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{延|の}びた→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to advances in medicine, average life expectancy has risen greatly over the past century.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延|の}びる→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧: life expectancy rises
- {平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ / ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: long / short life expectancy
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}: the average lifespan of a dog

RELATED WORDS:
- {健康寿命|けんこうじゅみょう}: healthy life expectancy, the years lived without needing care; often quoted beside {平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう} in Japanese health news
- ⟦{寿命|じゅみょう}→寿命：12359_jumyou⟧: lifespan (of a person or a thing)
